assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: premium realistic hosting service product preview for a professional website card.
Primary request: a photorealistic laptop displaying a polished modern business webpage, paired with a small physical stack of two compact brushed-metal servers and a clearly legible hosting control panel within the laptop screen.
Scene/backdrop: bright minimal off-white studio desk with soft architectural background, realistic premium product photography.
Subject: one open laptop three-quarter frontal view, subtle navy laptop display bezel, compact silver server stack beside it. The screen has a visually polished business website preview on one side and simple hosting settings on the other.
Text (verbatim): small concise hosting labels "Website", "SSL", "Mail", "Storage". All other website text should be minimal abstract lines, not gibberish blocks or marketing claims.
Style: real photograph, crisp materials, natural reflections, accurately constructed devices, calm trustworthy premium finish.
Composition/framing: horizontal 3:2 aspect ratio, wide generous framing with breathing room around all objects, camera at desk level, the complete laptop and servers in frame.
Lighting/mood: large soft daylight source, bright neutral shadows, off-white, deep navy, restrained cobalt blue and violet screen accents.
Constraints: no people, no giant floating interface, no data center, no code, no prices, no invented clients, stats, logos or watermarks. The scene must be a distinctive product photo.
assets.validation: Visually inspected; subjects, framing and limited UI text meet brief. No active status/checkmarks in forthcoming apps or domains concepts.
